svg.text: PARENTCONNECT — Parent ERD: Attendance History and Read State
Linked learner attendance, session context, guardian read receipts, and active school-year settings
PK primary key UQ unique field ● required ○ nullable
The parent dashboard reads attendance through linked learners; school-year configuration is an independent settings record.
Every connector uses a private route and endpoint; no shared segments or T-junctions are used.
